entries.title: a TOML table no longer claims the next table's header line
entries.summary: `end_line` for a TOML table ran one line past the table's own text, onto the line holding the NEXT table's header. Against `fastapi/fastapi` at `a64dfbbd`, `[build-system]` occupies lines 1-3 with a blank at 4 and reported `end_line=5` — the line holding `[project]`, a different symbol entirely.

entries.title: a cache truncated inside its last line is no longer attested as matching
entries.summary: Reported by [@rknighton](https://github.com/rknighton) in [#412](https://github.com/jgravelle/jcodemunch-mcp/issues/412), a follow-up to his own #401 whose patch introduced the prefix match this closes.

entries.title: duplicate source trees stop competing with the originals
entries.summary: `backup`, `old` and `archive` join the built-in directory skip list.
